drhp.business: ESAF Small Finance Bank provides banking services including advances, deposits, and financial literacy programmes, primarily targeting underserved and unbanked segments in rural and semi-urban India. The bank operates through a multi-channel network of banking outlets, ATMs, banking agents, and customer service centres, with a strategic emphasis on secured lending to MSME, Agriculture, Retail, and Gold sectors. It is undergoing a technology transformation under the ESAF 2.0 - StratoNext Programme to enhance digital capabilities and operational efficiency.
drhp.certs: ISO 9001:2015 recertification for Customer Service Quality functions
drhp.end_markets: Rural and semi-urban India|21 States and 2 Union Territories
drhp.expansion: ESAF Small Finance Bank continued to expand its physical and digital footprint during FY26. The branch network grew from 700 to 758 outlets, comprising 278 banking outlets, 380 business correspondent outlets, and 100 ultra-small branches. The ATM network was expanded to 558 machines. The bank also launched a new mobile banking application and internet banking platform to enhance digital reach. No specific new project names or commissioning timelines for future expansion were disclosed beyond the ongoing network growth.

drhp.one_liner: ESAF Small Finance Bank is a financial inclusion-focused small finance bank serving over 1 crore predominantly rural and semi-urban customers, now pivoting to a secured-lending model under the MARG framework.
